findings.claim: The three paginated getSubGroupsStream(...) overloads in GroupAdapter (lines 256, 262, 268) still call modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) without a null check. They throw a NullPointerException when the group is deleted concurrently, which is reachable through the GET /admin/realms/{realm}/groups/{id}/children endpoint.

The regression test never joins the background reader thread before asserting on caughtExceptions. The assertion runs immediately after deletedAll.set(true), so exceptions from in-flight reads can be missed and the thread can outlive the test.
